test_title: PYST 72: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

MSD: NHW:: OAE: LZV:: NIP:?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

MSD: NHW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c7050cdb59c655f007f2d0758f805370e23bb59dbcc5743c05b3195d578d033.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a2ea36c9685fbe585e0195662404a1db60fa77b8e325996ab48f24bcf84a2ed.png] 

OAE: LZV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46a4e161736fdd1b5e45bd49d18a52278c5365d008afeee9af3004a76627d499.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5cbd9cbc6cc69bb86ed7d9eb0b50a536bfe487a2c6c072c097f425bc5d6ce3d.png] 

Similarly, NIP:?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb1144517ef0e134d7b6e3ce338519e714249dfaf69ecf3a8009abcac1f938d6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b5824b36157408bb9e6710766966e23a83af88a20eb5e5556e37cf4ee60e3ac.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "MRK".
